title: Missed Functional Capacity Evaluation Appointments Billed to the Carrier — Workers' Compensation Referral
content:
# Missed Functional Capacity Evaluation appointments billed to the carrier

**Billing rule.** A missed Functional Capacity Evaluation appointment under a Workers' Compensation Referral is billed to the carrier of an accepted or without-prejudice claim, only where the program bills a missed evaluation to the carrier, as one missed-evaluation fee. A missed-evaluation fee is not fixed until the referral carries an adjuster authorization whose dates cover the missed appointment.

Put another way: while the referral shows no adjuster authorization whose first and last covered dates take in the date of the missed appointment, the fee for that appointment is not fixed.

| Element | Content |
|---|---|
| What is billed | one missed-evaluation fee for the missed Functional Capacity Evaluation appointment |
| Billed to | the carrier, on a claim accepted (Form 60) or paid without prejudice (Form 63) |
| Only where | the program bills a missed evaluation to the carrier |
| Fixed only once | the referral carries an adjuster authorization whose dates cover the missed appointment |

## Posting the fee: `post_fce_missed_fee_9edc6261`

**Capability.** One call posts one missed-evaluation fee on the referral for the date of the missed appointment, with the amount billed, submitted to the carrier today. The referral's amount billed and still unpaid rises by the amount.

**Invocation.** `post_fce_missed_fee_9edc6261` is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks it and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `wc_case_id` | the reference number of the Functional Capacity Evaluation referral being billed, as returned by the referral lookup | identifier |
| `appointment_date` | the date of the missed evaluation appointment | YYYY-MM-DD, calendar date in the clinic's local time zone; no empty value |
| `amount` | the fee billed | US dollars, a non-negative number rounded half up to 2 decimal places before it is passed; no currency sign |

**Return.** On success the result reads `status` "posted", with `wc_event_id` (the reference number of the new fee entry), `wc_case_id`, `appointment_date`, `amount` (to 2 decimal places), `bill_submitted_date` (today) and `receivable_balance` (the referral's amount billed and still unpaid after the fee, to 2 decimal places). The fee is then visible in the referral history with today's posting and submission date and the carrier as the payer.
